svg.font-family: Noto Sans SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Source Han Sans SC, sans-serif

g.text: adc_ref | Replica servo, native follower and VCM divider
Implicit bodies: NMOS -> VSS; startup PMOS -> AVDD18. Divider PMOS bodies remain explicit.
W/L in metres; W is total width per multiplier. Main divider: 8u/120n, nf4, x14; replica: 4u/120n, nf2.
MOM: 80 fingers, 40u length, 50n width/space, layers 1..5. CGATE x16; other main-level capacitors x1.
